# Behavioral Psychology

> An independent educational publication explaining behavioral psychology: core ideas, degree programs, careers, and real-world applications. Written and evidence-reviewed by Hassam Shabbir. Content is educational only and not professional advice; the author is not a licensed clinician.

## Key facts

- Behavioral psychology studies how environment and learning shape behavior, through principles such as classical conditioning, operant conditioning, and reinforcement.
- Degree paths include bachelor's, master's (MS or MA), and doctoral (PhD) programs; accredited online options exist at every level.
- Career paths span research, education, business (including UX and organizational roles), and health-related fields.
- The author is not a licensed clinician. All content is educational and never a substitute for professional advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
